messages:
alex: Heads-up — I pushed a PRD draft for SLO-driven graceful degradation on /generate. Need eng + infra + product sign-off. Customer ask: p95 <= 200ms for paid tier, availability 99.95%. Draft proposes tiered fallbacks (quantized model + token cap) and error-budget-triggered routing to Dedicated capacity. Link: https://redwood.internal/prd/slo-degrade
priya: Reading now. Quick q: are we committing to 200ms p95 globally or region-specific? customer asked about EU latency too.
sarah: From runtime side: 200ms p95 for 2k tokens is unrealistic on current hosted fleet without aggressive batching. Suggest p95 target for 512 tokens. Otherwise we'd need reserved pools or heavier quantization. Also we need clear acceptance criteria and a test harness.
jamal: Agree with sarah. Proposal: define two SLOs — (1) latency SLO (p95) on normalized load (avg seq len 256) and (2) availability SLA for paid tier. Graceful degrade order: cache hits -> prompt-shortening hints -> fallback to v2-quantized -> prefer Dedicated routing. Define error-budget burn thresholds and auto-pause rollouts.
priya: Can we make acceptance criteria runnable checks? e.g., "on benchmark harness with X QPS and seq=256 p95 <= 200ms" plus "fallback test: inject 1% node failure -> success rate >= 99%".
sarah: I'll add benchmarks. Observability needs: per-route token breakdown, model-variant counts, cache hit rates, circuit-breaker metrics. If error budget <= 20% remaining over 24h then trigger canary rollback to smaller model.
alex: Also add customer-facing SLA table: what we guarantee and what counts as force majeure. We'll get legal in loop but draft here.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy: started canary for prd/slo-degrade at 1750001500 by sarah (5% traffic)
sarah: :thumbsup: running load test now.
jamal: Edge case: streaming + function calls — must not drop partial responses. Acceptance: streaming sessions either finish or send explicit partial 'incomplete' token with reason; add to PRD.
priya: For launch criteria propose: 1) benchmark p95 pass at target, 2) observability dashboards live, 3) rollback playbook tested, 4) legal SLA signoff, 5) runbook for CS.
alex: Add an error budget policy snippet in PRD, e.g.:
```
error_budget_policy:
  window: 30d
  threshold_warning: 40%
  threshold_blocking: 20%
  actions:
    - warning: page on-call
    - blocking: prefer Dedicated routing for paid tier up to capacity and notify customer
```
jamal: Change wording to 'prefer Dedicated up to X capacity then degrade to smaller model' — need explicit caps.
sarah: Add regression evals for quality in acceptance: avg quality delta <= 1% vs baseline for fallback variants (automated eval harness).
priya: I'll update PRD with these items and ping legal + solutions eng. Can we freeze scope for MVP? No multi-region auto-fallback — v2.
alex: Agreed. Next steps: priya updates PRD, sarah attaches bench results, jamal writes automation for error-budget triggers, alex to consolidate and send to execs by EOD Friday.
jamal: I'll add k8s rollout job and alert mapping.
sarah: Load test summary: p95=210ms on seq=256 with quantized v2, ~10% headroom; will push improvements and upload results to PRD.
priya: Thanks team. Quick note: customer success asked to include SLA credits language — adding placeholder.
alex: Thanks all — I'll mark PRD 'ready for review' once updates are in. :rocket:
